bio: Opposite Saint-Sauveur Church, this unusual-looking building resembling a small castle houses the restaurant of chef Alexandre Loiseau and Sandra Côté. The traditional cuisine served here is made using impeccable local produce: knuckle of suckling pig from the Gaspor family farm, boudin noir and maple-glazed sweetbreads, or flat iron steak cooked with mushrooms and red wine. Lunchtime revolves around a set menu formule (with optional extras); the evening à la carte menu offers more choice. Delicious desserts and a warm welcome seal the deal – a lovely place.
